title: Google Just Killed ChatGPT With This Update
full_monologue: **Google Just Killed ChatGPT With This Update**. Imagine a world where AI doesn’t just respond—it anticipates. Google’s latest update does just that, making ChatGPT feel outdated. Think faster processing, smarter context, and seamless integration across devices. It’s not just an upgrade—it’s a revolution. And now, the question is: Will ChatGPT ever catch up?
